newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE MONEY RATES MIXED IN ACTIVE TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE MONEY RATES MIXED IN ACTIVE TRADE.

text.p: Short term trading rates on Zimbabwe's money market were quoted stable to firmer in Monday's liquid market, dealers said.
"There's quite a bit of activity on the market this morning," one dealer commented.
He said discount houses were buying treasury bills from the central Reserve Bank at a steady 19 percent.
NCD bills redeemable after 30, 60 and 90 days edged up to 20.50 percent from 19.50 percent but bankers acceptances were unchanged at last Friday's 19.50 percent across the board.
Call money added one percentage point to 19 percent in a market which was Z$52.3 million in surplus at settlement, down from Z$164 million previously.
